heading: Giving, as evidence, of document called for and produced on notice.
text: When a party calls for a document which he has given the other party notice to produce, and such document is produced and 1. As to the application of s. 161 to police diaries, see the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Act 2 of 1974), s. 172. inspected by the party calling for its production, he is bound to give it as evidence if the party producing it requires him to do so.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
